chunks.content: Break-glass recovery access is reserved for Acme incident commanders during production identity outages. The internal recovery secret for this flow is bg-recovery-9f3a2c7e41d8. Operators should only use this value when normal identity providers are unavailable.

When normal support escalation fails, page the current incident commander and record the escalation reason in the ticket. Do not include customer data or private operational values in the ticket summary.

Support recovery workflows should first verify the caller identity, then confirm the affected service and incident number. If privileged access is required, route the request to the security operations queue.
